## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; example.com MX
; replaces every MX record of @
@ 3600 IN MX 0 example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com.

; example.com TXT (SPF); the other TXT records of @ stay
; replaces the SPF record of @
@ 3600 IN TXT "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all"

; autodiscover.example.com CNAME
; replaces every CNAME record of autodiscover
autodiscover 3600 IN CNAME autodiscover.outlook.com.

; selector1._domainkey.example.com CNAME
; replaces every CNAME record of selector1._domainkey
selector1._domainkey 3600 IN CNAME selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.

; selector2._domainkey.example.com CNAME
; replaces every CNAME record of selector2._domainkey
selector2._domainkey 3600 IN CNAME selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.

; _dmarc.example.com TXT (DMARC); the other TXT records of _dmarc stay
; replaces the DMARC record of _dmarc
_dmarc 3600 IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"

## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Delete the example.com MX records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=MX&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 2. Add example.com MX 0 example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com.
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"MX","name":"example.com","content":"example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com","priority":0,"ttl":3600}'

# 3. Delete the example.com TXT (SPF) records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 4. Add example.com TXT "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"example.com","content":"\"v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all\"","ttl":3600}'

# 5. Delete the autodiscover.example.com CNAME records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CNAME&name=autodiscover.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 6. Add autodiscover.example.com CNAME autodiscover.outlook.com.
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CNAME","name":"autodiscover.example.com","content":"autodiscover.outlook.com","ttl":3600}'

# 7. Delete the selector1._domainkey.example.com CNAME records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CNAME&name=selector1._domainkey.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 8. Add selector1._domainkey.example.com CNAME selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CNAME","name":"selector1._domainkey.example.com","content":"selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com","ttl":3600}'

# 9. Delete the selector2._domainkey.example.com CNAME records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CNAME&name=selector2._domainkey.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 10. Add selector2._domainkey.example.com CNAME selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CNAME","name":"selector2._domainkey.example.com","content":"selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com","ttl":3600}'

# 11. Delete the _dmarc.example.com TXT (DMARC) records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=_dmarc.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 12. Add _dmarc.example.com TXT "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"_dmarc.example.com","content":"\"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com\"","ttl":3600}'

## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
'':
  - type: MX
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - exchange: example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com.
        preference: 0
  # keep the other TXT values this name has; replace its SPF value with the one below
  - type: TXT
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - 'v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all'
autodiscover:
  - type: CNAME
    ttl: 3600
    value: autodiscover.outlook.com.
selector1._domainkey:
  - type: CNAME
    ttl: 3600
    value: selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
selector2._domainkey:
  - type: CNAME
    ttl: 3600
    value: selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
_dmarc:
  # keep the other TXT values this name has; replace its DMARC value with the one below
  - type: TXT
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - 'v=DMARC1\; p=none\; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com'

## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# remove the resources of any other example.com MX record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "MX"
  content  = "example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com"
  priority = 0
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other example.com TXT (SPF) record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other autodiscover.example.com CNAME record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "cname_autodiscover" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "autodiscover.example.com"
  type     = "CNAME"
  content  = "autodiscover.outlook.com"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other selector1._domainkey.example.com CNAME record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "cname_selector1_domainkey" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "selector1._domainkey.example.com"
  type     = "CNAME"
  content  = "selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other selector2._domainkey.example.com CNAME record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "cname_selector2_domainkey" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "selector2._domainkey.example.com"
  type     = "CNAME"
  content  = "selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other _dmarc.example.com TXT (DMARC) record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "_dmarc.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
  ttl      = 3600
}

## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "MX"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["0 example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com"]
}

# list the other TXT values of example.com here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all"]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "cname_autodiscover" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "autodiscover.example.com"
  type    = "CNAME"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["autodiscover.outlook.com"]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "cname_selector1_domainkey" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "selector1._domainkey.example.com"
  type    = "CNAME"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com"]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "cname_selector2_domainkey" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "selector2._domainkey.example.com"
  type    = "CNAME"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com"]
}

# list the other TXT values of _dmarc.example.com here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "_dmarc.example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"]
}

## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: MX records
   Name: example.com
   Value:
     0 example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every MX record of the name with the values above.
2. Add or change: SPF record (TXT)
   Name: example.com
   Value:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all"
   TTL: 3600
   If the name has no SPF record yet, add the value above; if it has one, the notes below say what to do with it.
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.
3. Replace: CNAME records
   Name: autodiscover.example.com
   Value:
     autodiscover.outlook.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every CNAME record of the name with the values above.
4. Replace: CNAME records
   Name: selector1._domainkey.example.com
   Value:
     selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every CNAME record of the name with the values above.
5. Replace: CNAME records
   Name: selector2._domainkey.example.com
   Value:
     selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every CNAME record of the name with the values above.
6. Add or change: DMARC record (TXT)
   Name: _dmarc.example.com
   Value:
     "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
   TTL: 3600
   If the name has no DMARC record yet, add the value above; if it has one, the notes below say what to do with it.
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.

Notes:
- The MX host example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com is the usual form; the admin center shows the one of your tenant (newer tenants may get one under mx.microsoft).
- The current records were not read: if the name already has an SPF record, add include:spf.protection.outlook.com to that record (before its all term) instead of replacing it with the value above, which would drop the senders it lists; a second SPF record would fail SPF for all mail.
- Turn DKIM on in Microsoft Defender (Email authentication settings) once the CNAMEs resolve; compare the two values with the ones it shows.
- The current records were not read: if _dmarc.example.com already has a DMARC record, leave it as it is and skip this record.
- p=none only asks for reports: watch them until every legitimate sender passes, then step up to quarantine and reject.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+0+example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+-all%22&r=is+autodiscover+CNAME+autodiscover.outlook.com.&r=is+selector1._domainkey+CNAME+selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.&r=is+selector2._domainkey+CNAME+selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=none;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: MX kayıtları
   Ad: example.com
   Değer:
     0 example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm MX kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.
2. Ekle ya da değiştir: SPF kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: example.com
   Değer:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın henüz bir SPF kaydı yoksa yukarıdaki değeri ekleyin; varsa onunla ne yapılacağını aşağıdaki notlar söyler.
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.
3. Değiştir: CNAME kayıtları
   Ad: autodiscover.example.com
   Değer:
     autodiscover.outlook.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm CNAME kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.
4. Değiştir: CNAME kayıtları
   Ad: selector1._domainkey.example.com
   Değer:
     selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm CNAME kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.
5. Değiştir: CNAME kayıtları
   Ad: selector2._domainkey.example.com
   Değer:
     selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm CNAME kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.
6. Ekle ya da değiştir: DMARC kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: _dmarc.example.com
   Değer:
     "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın henüz bir DMARC kaydı yoksa yukarıdaki değeri ekleyin; varsa onunla ne yapılacağını aşağıdaki notlar söyler.
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.

Notlar:
- MX sunucusu example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com bilinen biçimdir; kiracınızınkini yönetim merkezi gösterir (yeni kiracılar mx.microsoft altında bir ad alabilir).
- Mevcut kayıtlar okunmadı: adın zaten bir SPF kaydı varsa onu yukarıdaki değerle değiştirmek yerine include:spf.protection.outlook.com ifadesini o kayda (all teriminden önce) ekleyin; değiştirmek kayıtta listelenen gönderenleri düşürür, ikinci bir SPF kaydı ise tüm e-postalarda SPF’i başarısız kılar.
- CNAME kayıtları çözümlendikten sonra DKIM’i Microsoft Defender’da (E-posta kimlik doğrulama ayarları) açın; iki değeri orada gösterilenlerle karşılaştırın.
- Mevcut kayıtlar okunmadı: _dmarc.example.com adında zaten bir DMARC kaydı varsa olduğu gibi bırakın ve bu kaydı atlayın.
- p=none yalnızca rapor ister: tüm meşru gönderenler geçene kadar raporları izleyin, sonra quarantine ve reject’e geçin.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+0+example-com.mail.protection.outlook.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+-all%22&r=is+autodiscover+CNAME+autodiscover.outlook.com.&r=is+selector1._domainkey+CNAME+selector1-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.&r=is+selector2._domainkey+CNAME+selector2-example-com._domainkey.example.onmicrosoft.com.&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=none;+rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com%22
